info.title: Prospecter API
info.description:
Exposes the use cases of `prospecter/core`.

Authentication: the members sign in with the Cognito user pool of `GET /api/user-pool`
(SRP, client of the SPA), then send `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` on every call.

Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`);
validation errors list the invalid fields in `violations`.

open.description: Whether the page offers slots. A closed, changed, unknown or suspended page offers none and says nothing else

host.description: Who the booker meets. Null when the page offers nothing

timeZone.description: The host's clock, on which the days and the slots are given. Null when the page offers nothing

days.description: The 14 days from tomorrow on the host's clock, each with the start times of its free 15-minute slots. Empty when the page offers nothing

cognito.description: An access token of the Cognito user pool
